subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**skills**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how Santosh Bisen effectively used his abilities to create comic strips from science chapters.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the specific abilities or talent he utilized for this purpose.
 
• **"Skills"** fits well as it denotes his ability to draw, which aligns with the context of converting chapters into comic strips.
 
• Other options ('**terms**', '**tricks**', '**art**') do not directly convey the talent or ability necessary for this task.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Santosh Bisen, science teacher and cartoonist at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya in Durg, Chhattisgarh used__ his drawing **__skills__** to convert chapters into comic strips. "Convincing authorities to turn textbooks into comics was difficult. I spent my own money to (3)________ textbooks. I also used cartoons in question papers," he says. "Students were (4)________ with how simple science became and their performance (5)_________," he adds.** *

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Terms **(शर्तें): "Terms" means conditions or words, which does not fit the context of discussing his abilities.
 
• **Tricks **(चाल): "Tricks" means clever actions intended to achieve something, which does not capture the essence of his drawing talent.
 
• **Art **(कला): "Art" means the expression or application of human creative skill, which is related but does not precisely convey his ability to draw in this context.
